cues.text: Peddy, wake up, I smell a secret midnight cookie jar!
Let us sneak into the kitchen right now!
Look, the hidden jar of sweet cookies is right on the top shelf!
Help me reach it before anyone hears us!
Got it! Now let us open it very quietly.
Hand one over before they wake up!
Oh no, a crumb fell right on the floor!
Wait, why are those little paws moving near the stove?
Someone woke me up for a midnight snack too!
A cat in the kitchen, hide the jar fast!
Run, it is chasing us across the living room carpet!
Take this shield to block its path!
We ran right out the front door into the street!
Look, the whole neighbourhood is completely dark and quiet.
Let us hide behind these park bushes with our jar!
At least we secured our secret midnight feast!
Who left the empty cookie jar out on the table?!
Uh oh, our secret mission is busted!
